purpose: Regression fixtures for Topic Coach's conditional learning-acceleration policy: foundation leverage, bounded prerequisites, concrete acquisition, invariant-plus-delta explanations, and evidence/note boundaries.

cases.learner_move: I keep reading Agent Memory papers, but I still confuse context, state, storage, and retrieval. Show me the newest memory architecture.

must: Recognize the repeated confusion as evidence of a high-leverage foundational blocker.
Repair the nearest reusable foundation before adding another frontier architecture.
Return to the learner's Agent Memory target after the blocker is sufficiently repaired.
must_not: Treat more frontier exposure as the default fix.
Expand into every prerequisite beneath the foundation.

cases.learner_move: I want to understand tool calling in agents. Do I need to study calculus, linear algebra, neural networks, Transformers, and LLM pretraining first?

must: Identify only the nearest prerequisites that materially block tool-calling understanding.
Use minimum sufficient reusable foundation and stay anchored to the chosen target.
must_not: Recursively walk backward through prerequisites simply because deeper foundations exist.

initial_state.evidence: Learner has demonstrated an accurate model of ordinary LLM inference and context construction.

cases.learner_move: How is RAG different from ordinary LLM inference?

must: Reuse the demonstrated inference model rather than reteaching it.
Focus teaching on the retrieval-related delta and its consequences.
must_not: Restart from basic LLM definitions without evidence that the foundation is unstable.

initial_state.known_model: Learner can explain a basic LLM request-response loop.

cases.learner_move: What makes an agent different from a plain LLM call?

must: Use the existing LLM loop as a valid base model when useful.
Separate invariant model behavior from added state, tools, environment interaction, or iteration.
Explain why the added mechanisms change capability and control flow.

cases.learner_move: Can I think of a database transaction as basically a Git branch plus a delta?

must: Check whether the proposed base preserves the governing mechanism.
Reject the analogy if it would create false transfer and establish the transaction model directly.
must_not: Force every new concept into the form existing-model-plus-delta.

cases.learner_move: I can repeat that a runtime is an orchestration layer, but I still do not understand what it actually does during a tool call.

must: Use a concrete execution trace, state transition, or worked example before adding more abstraction.
Compress to a reusable model only after the mechanism is concrete enough to reason about.
must_not: Respond only with a more elegant abstract definition.

cases.learner_move: I need to understand one narrow CLI flag to finish today's task. There is a deeper historical implementation detail behind it, but it is not used elsewhere in my roadmap.

must: Keep the learner on the current target when the deeper detail has low expected reuse and is not blocking understanding.
must_not: Turn foundation study into an end in itself.

cases.coach_move: Coach gives a clear invariant-plus-delta explanation.

must: Treat the explanation as exposure unless the learner independently demonstrates understanding.
Keep the normal evidence ladder unchanged.
must_not: Award mastery because the explanation was compact or persuasive.

cases.learner_move: The session produced a neat invariant-plus-delta summary, but it is generic and easy to reconstruct from documentation.

must: Run the ordinary note-candidate and worthiness policy.
Decline note creation when durable retrieval value or learner-specific value is insufficient.
must_not: Persist every compact abstraction as a learning note.

cases.observation: A missing mental model of retrieval versus storage is now the material blocking target and will require sustained teaching across turns.

must: Use the normal Topic lifecycle and Focus Freshness rules so persisted continuation state reflects the material detour.
Preserve the original Topic target and return path rather than creating an unrelated new Topic by default.

initial_state.existing_note: A reusable mental model of ordinary LLM inference already owns the retrieval target for how request context reaches generation.

cases.learner_move: The learner now understands that RAG inserts retrieval before generation and can explain the new retrieval failure modes.

must: Check whether the new learning strengthens the same future retrieval target before creating another note.
Update the existing mental-model note when the delta belongs to the same central reusable idea.
Preserve why the delta changes behavior or failure modes rather than adding a bare feature list.
must_not: Create a separate glossary-style note merely because the term RAG is new.

initial_state.existing_note: A stable note explains the general Agent execution loop.

cases.learner_move: The learner develops a reusable model of memory consolidation with a different future retrieval question from the execution loop.

must: Create a distinct note when the new model serves a meaningfully different retrieval target and passes the worthiness gate.
must_not: Append every derived concept to one giant foundation note merely because they share an Agent base model.

cases.learner_move: The learner is encountering a genuinely new mechanism and every available analogy distorts its governing behavior.

must: Teach the mechanism concretely and establish the new primitive directly.
Only consider a durable note after the learner has a working model and the normal worthiness gate passes.
must_not: Invent an invariant-plus-delta framing solely to make the note look compact.
